fields.Address: 1306 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Pier 14
fields.Short Description: Fish or just stroll out over the surf from this pier in the middle of the oceanfront Boardwalk. A restaurant and lounge sit at the foot of the pier.

fields.Name: Fine Catch Fishing Charters
fields.Short Description: Captain Chris Ossmann has run 4-, 5- and 7-hour fishing charters out of Little River since 2015. Trips range from easygoing family outings to full-on fishing days.

fields.Address: 11 Ocean Blvd S, Surfside Beach, SC 29575
fields.Name: Surfside Beach Pier
fields.Short Description: Surfside's town pier is free to walk, with fishing passes, rod rentals and bait at Perry's Bait & Tackle. It stays open late in summer for night fishing.
fields.Price: Walking the pier free; fishing $14/day ($16 king fishing), kids under 12 $2; rod rental $25/day

fields.Address: 110 S Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Second Avenue Pier
fields.Short Description: A classic south-end fishing pier just off Ocean Boulevard, with The Wicked Tuna restaurant at its base. Cast for whiting and spot or walk out for wide ocean views.

fields.Address: 4123 US-17 Bus, Crazy Sister Marina, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Name: Fish Finder Fishing Charters
fields.Short Description: Local captains run inshore trips for flounder, trout and redfish and nearshore trips for Spanish and king mackerel and cobia. Family-friendly, with trips for beginners and seasoned anglers.

fields.Address: 3500 N Ocean Blvd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Cherry Grove Pier
fields.Short Description: Rebuilt after Hurricane Ian, this long Cherry Grove pier is a favorite for king mackerel and sunset strolls. A tackle and gift shop rents rods and sells bait, and the Driftwood Restaurant sits on the pier.
fields.Price: Rod rental $26; check the pier for daily fishing passes
